title: JANUS Ideal Slime Activation Contract
thesis: The ideal activation Slime is a compositional adaptive-routing layer. It may learn which routes and micro-parameters work, but it must remain subordinate to provenance, verification, safety, authority and durable audit gates.

plane_2_navigation_and_adaptation.role: Generate and adapt diverse candidate routes.

plane_3_safety_and_control.role: Prevent learned shortcuts from bypassing execution law.

plane_4_memory_and_audit.role: Separate high-frequency adaptive state from canonical durable memory.

ideal_selection_rule: Prefer the smallest composable set of mechanisms that satisfies all hard invariants and wins adversarial/holdout activation tests. Do not choose a historical Slime merely because it is newest, largest, fastest, or named TRUE/GOLDEN/ABSOLUTE.
anti_patterns: auto-send or side effects before independent gate
unbounded global bias from local memory
restart-unsafe time semantics for persisted decay
silent fallback that looks like success
winner selection from training arena without anchor/holdout/adversarial replay

required_test_families: semantic mismatch vs transport failure discrimination
arena holdout against fixed anchor baseline
acceptance_gate.pass_semantics: PASS only when all hard invariants are demonstrated by receipts/logs on a clean state and replay consistently. Timeout/resource exhaustion is UNKNOWN_RESOURCE_LIMIT, not negative evidence.

claim_ceiling: This is a project design contract extracted from historical JANUS code patterns. It is not a claim that one implementation is globally optimal, biologically faithful, safe without testing, or scientifically validated.
